_doc: ADR-0033: registry of chosen-to-defer (pending-activation) items only. Declared-gap permanents live in coverage-map.json; chosen-not-to-build items (e.g. judgeSeam, ADR-0019 D4) stay in ADRs per MADR. review_at expiry is fail-closed: activate, re-defer with new review_at + rationale, or remove. Anchors are existence-based: source_adr file must exist and the entry id must appear in any docs/adr/*.md or CONTEXT.md (typically the registering ADR). Enforced by scripts/check-deferred.js (deferred:gate). ADR-0035 additions: every entry carries cadence_tier (quarterly|half-yearly|yearly, review cadence ladder D1) and registered_at (D2 residency SLA: pending-evaluation may not outstay min(2 cycles, 12 months)); external-event entries carry last_check_in{date,note} with at least one check-in per cycle (warn-level, D3); presence-condition/count-threshold entries must carry verified_by pointing to an existing assertion script or be downgraded to pending-evaluation (D6, fail-closed).

entries.subject: supply-chain signing (sigstore keyless / SLSA provenance)
entries.rationale: Single maintainer, local-only distribution (no remote, no npm publish, no CI): signing infrastructure buys nothing until at least one distribution channel exists. ADR-0029 D7 registers signing as a rejected-for-now item with explicit re-activation conditions.

entries.rationale: ADR-0034 R4: ci.yml is a single-consumer ~30-line file; a renderer would hide intent drift behind a build step (ADR-0032 D2 anti-precedent). The D5 line-level wiring assertion (scripts/check-ci-wiring.js) covers the drift risk at zero build-layer cost.

entries.subject: verify the 8 long-tail host protocols against official documentation
entries.rationale: Split out of defer-0002 by ADR-0035 D4 (one entry, one condition type). L1/L2 golden conformance for the 8 long-tail hosts must not ship until each protocol is verified against its official documentation; serial atomcode research per host is the verification channel. Stays in this registry, not coverage-map.json (ADR-0035 R5: different namespace).

entries.subject: MR corpus v2 pipeline: LLM-generated candidate transforms + independent semantic-preservation judge (ASE 2026 two-layer, different model family) + paired McNemar (Amazon LLM-Accuracy-Stats) + FWER control
entries.rationale: v1 is hand-authored because judge-validated machine generation cannot feed a zero-false-positive corpus (LLMorph: unverified transforms are only ~42-60% true positives). Scaling past ~12 pairs needs the two-layer pipeline and paired statistics; both are buildable on demand, so v1 is frozen instead of pre-built.

unfreeze_if.check: any single MR family accumulates >= 30 real cases (the ADR-0029 D3 graduation line), OR a freshness cycle demands corpus regeneration at a scale hand-authoring cannot carry

entries.subject: private-registry corpus distribution channel (publish=false / access-controlled npm registry package, Cargo/Turborepo internal-package pattern)
entries.rationale: No external consumer demand exists today; the maintainer/CI channel (CI secret tar) covers all real reproduction needs. Building the channel now would pay the two-package version-sync cost for zero demand (ADR-0038 R1 reasoning).

unfreeze_if.check: a real external consumer of the benchmark corpus exists (an external team attempting reproduction) AND an access-controlled private channel is provisioned

entries.subject: local-file:<path> escape form for gate capability probing (one-off custom gates)
entries.rationale: The four-capability closed enum covers all 18 current gates; an unconstrained escape slides toward an expression language. systemd precedent: X- prefix is a reserved namespace, not an open verb; if built, it must be prefix-scoped, relative-path-only, and inside the coupling guard's scan range.

unfreeze_if.check: a real gate needs an arbitrary-path capability outside the closed enum

entries.subject: scoring-function isolation for capable-optimizer defense
entries.rationale: ADR-0036 already isolates corpus data; ADR-0045 records the separate execution-boundary concern. Scoring code must not be readable or mutable by the generator before it runs, but there is no current score-bearing verifier implementation to protect.

unfreeze_if.check: a scoring-mode verifier or LLM-judge runtime exists and is reachable by the generator

entries.subject: Lyft-style prompt contradiction and dead-path linting
entries.rationale: Current adapter drift and structural checks catch shape drift, not contradictory or dead instruction paths. Adding an LLM-level prompt linter would introduce a new review dependency before the existing static gates demonstrate the need.

entries.subject: Human-labeled anchor corpus and annotation manual for the judge revalidation admission gate
entries.rationale: The human-anchor admission gate (ADR-0046 D-D) requires a frozen human-labeled corpus with a human-human kappa baseline, expert rotation, and a 60-90 day refresh; that asset does not exist yet.

unfreeze_if.check: the ADR-0046 implementation round opens and a frozen human-labeled anchor corpus with annotation manual is commissioned

entries.subject: silent-drift anytime-valid auto-detection: anchor e-process + guard-window attribution to {none, system, judge}
entries.rationale: ADR-0047 D-E defers silent provider drift detection behind its two prerequisites: the human-labeled anchor corpus (defer-0015) and a trustworthy scheduler carrier (CONTEXT.md Reverification Runbook rejects cron/CI without a trusted remote executor). Building before the anchor set exists would replicate the naive-z ~75% false-alarm failure.

unfreeze_if.check: defer-0015's frozen human-labeled anchor corpus with annotation manual is committed and schema-valid, AND a trustworthy scheduler carrier exists (CI cron with a trusted remote executor, or equivalent), AND the reverify pipeline wires the ADR-0046 D-A identity triple

entries.subject: data-driven calibration interval and offset-band feedback (staircase / reliability-ratio + guard-band)
entries.rationale: ADR-0047 D-F keeps the 6/9-month dead-man clock as initial interval and floor while the reverify ledger accumulates as-found/as-left history. Data-driven interval adjustment needs enough same-identity cycles and flip-eligible samples plus the anchor set before a control decision is statistically honest.

unfreeze_if.check: the same identity has accumulated >= 2-3 complete reverify cycles AND >= 30 flip-eligible samples (ADR-0029 D3 graduation line) AND defer-0015's anchor set is available

entries.subject: criteria-change pointwise replay (as-left re-projection pipeline)
entries.rationale: ADR-0049 D-D requires pointwise replayable judge input before a criteria change can produce a genuine as-left re-projection. The current ledger retains aggregate values only, so criteria change must fall back to restatement mapping until input retention and the anchor set exist.

unfreeze_if.check: the metrological ledger is authoritative AND pointwise judge input retention (claim/toolResults/heuristicVerdict) is implemented AND defer-0015's anchor set is available

entries.subject: external witness / second-copy anchor for the evidence-log tip and genesis (independent-domain mirror: transparency log / timestamp / DNS TXT / second host)
entries.rationale: ADR-0050 D-B lands the install-time local genesis anchor and tail sidecar first. An external second copy raises detection strength from same-host to cross-domain (detection strength equals anchor independence) but requires network or a third-party trust domain; deferred until a cross-machine verification requirement or second-party consumer exists.

unfreeze_if.check: a cross-machine verification requirement or a second-party consumer of the evidence log exists outside the producing host

last_check_in.note: minimal unlock (ADR-0061 D-E C-2): authoritative governance copies now live in git-tracked docs/governance/ with machine-generated witnessed digests (anchors.json), giving a same-repo second copy. BAR STATEMENT (SPEC-3 repair, 2026-09-13): this git-commit witness does NOT satisfy the unfreeze condition and must not be recorded as if it did. ADR-0050/ADR-0061 D-E state explicitly that git alone is not tamper-proof, so a same-repo git copy is not an independent-domain witness - it shares the producing host, the repository, and the trust domain of the very record it would corroborate (detection strength equals anchor independence). The external/cross-domain half of the unfreeze condition therefore remains UNMET; defer-0024 stays open. External witness deadline for the next mandatory check-in: 2027-09-01 (this entry's review_at), with an interim obligation to re-check at each full-year tide.

entries.subject: host-native directory synchronization capability upgrade
entries.rationale: ADR-0051 records the closed persistence capability class. The current runtime uses dir-sync-unsupported on Windows; promoting it to dir-sync-durable requires a documented portable directory-fsync primitive from Node or Windows, not a local adapter or new dependency.

unfreeze_if.check: the target runtime exposes a documented and supported portable directory-fsync primitive

Activation also satisfies the defer-0004 presence condition, whose evaluation must run in the same round.

Scoped and unprefixed names do not conflict; creating the npm user/org for the scope is cheap and time-sensitive (names are first-come, hard to transfer).

entries.subject: heterogeneous-model independent review channel (independent review layer)
entries.rationale: ADR-0059 D-D: wiring tests are coherence-tier limited assurance; same-author verification cannot claim IEEE 1012 independence. A cross-family model review channel converts the unfalsifiable same-boundary charge into a measurable, bookable engineering object. Honest bound: it provides partial technical independence only — managerial/financial independence is out of reach and labeled as such (cross-family confident errors partially shared, rho ~0.47).

Facts-correction edits (e.g. D-004 wording) remain licensed at any time; polish requires anchored defects.
